sentences.span: Even if Brent and WTI remain within the recent range... heating oil is near recent highs... remain cautious on duration now that month-end support has passed
sentences.why: The month-end/duration-caution claim matches, but the source explicitly says Brent/WTI are range-bound, not near highs; only the product complex (heating oil) is near highs. Generalizing this to 'energy' being nearer the high end of its range changes what the source says.

sentences.span: The sell-off is fundamental, not fragile. The tell for us is what isn't happening: rates vol hasn't broken higher. Forecasts still have 10 year yields down 30-40bp if the driver goes away.
